name: Who Am I (SA)
help: Displays current identity information; Linux and macOS return reduced POSIX details.
long_help: On Windows, returns whoami /all-style username, SID, group membership, and token-privilege information. On Linux and macOS, reports the login name when available plus real/effective UID and GID values only; it does not enumerate supplementary groups, SIDs, or Windows token privileges.
